pages.text: On this page Nurse Babes — Full Brand Intelligence All 7 Steps · Cycle: May 14 – Aug 14, 2026 · Approved by Adrienne STEP 0 Engagement Setup PREP — Brand Overview & Strategic Context 🔒 META COMPLIANCE LOCK (Adrienne Directive — Non-Negotiable) AVOID in paid ads: pain-free / pain-relief / cure / treat / heal / fix / medical-grade / therapeutic. USE INSTEAD: comfort / support / all-day / cloud-like / show up strong. Customer testimonial quotes are EXEMPT as third-party voice. FTC Gravity Defyer precedent (Feb 2025, $175K penalty) — NB current copy at risk. Brand Nurse Babes — nursebabes.com Comfortable, supportive, affordable footwear designed by/for nurses and healthcare professionals. 565,000+ customer base. Core product: Ortho Pro 1.0. Mission: Empower nurses to feel good, look good, and handle their hard lives better. Positioning For nurses and anyone on their feet all day, Nurse Babes is the orthopedic footwear brand that delivers podiatrist-recommended, all-day comfort without the bulk, ugliness, or $200+ price tag of clinical alternatives. Tone: Warm, peer-to-peer Nurse-to-nurse No-BS, slightly cheeky Mantra: Wear What Feels Good. 565K Customer Base $80 Price Point (sale) 40+ Colorways 92% Meta Spend Concentration Key Differentiators Designed BY/WITH nurses (founder Hadley + healthcare advisory) Podiatrist-recommended (claim) Affordable orthopedic — under $80 sale vs competitors $130–200 HSA/FSA eligible Cloud comfort + non-slip + wide toe-box combo 40+ colorways across product lines 565K customer community Identity-brand pivot — Alo trajectory underway 10 Growth Levers (PREP Insights) 1 Non-Nurse UGC Winners Top-performing UGC winners are NON-NURSES posing as nurse-endorsed — breaks the "we need real nurses on camera" assumption. 2 Shipping Is The NPS Killer Top NPS detractor is shipping from China, not the product. ~30% of negative reviews: "weeks waiting", "I would not have ordered if I knew it was coming from China." 3 Clove Community Gap Clove has NBNA partnership, $300K donations, Fit Guarantee, 4.9/5 stars. NB has 565K customers but zero community/social-good infrastructure. 4 Stay Out of Kuru's Lane Kuru attacks broad foot-pain market with medical authority ($130–190). NB should NOT chase. Stay in tribe-identity lane. 5 BOGO Is Fatigued, Not Broken B2G1 carries +27% AOV lift ($92→$118) over 17 months. Right move: layer non-BOGO acquisition angle while BOGO continues. 6 55% Are Not Nurses ~55% of customers are NOT nurses (service industry, SAHM, teachers, pregnant, post-surgery, vet techs). One customer has 11 pairs: "I am not a nurse." 7 Identity Pivot Underway New logo (THICK variant) spring 2025, Apparel folder live. Step 5 locks identity-brand framing: "Alo for nurses." 8 Comfort Club Launched Zero Creative Comfort Club launched May 14, 2026 with zero onboarding creative. 70 subscribers at launch at 20% PDP exposure = ~$2.8K MRR. 9 TikTok = $0 Paid 92% paid-spend in Meta with declining ROAS (2.24→1.93). TikTok is active organically but has $0 in paid spend. 10 Attribution Chaos $60 ncCPA target vs ~$160 last-click vs ~$320 first-click. Triple disagreement. Every creative decision affected until reconciled. 16 Source Files Ingested NB ICP Survey · Brand Building & Mission Doc · Competitor Master List · Raw Research Doc · Customer Survey (652 responses) · Brand Content Calendar · Main Media Folder · Photoshoots · Top UGC Videos · Top Ads · Logos · Reviews 1 & 2 · Kuru Footwear Research · Funnels Per Concept STEP 1 Brand Profile Brand DNA & Performance History Approved by Adrienne · May 14, 2026 $118 AOV with B2G1 $93 Base AOV 1.93 Current ROAS 1,100+ Active Meta Ads Product Line Ortho Pro 1.0 — Hero SKU, 40+ colorways, $69.99–$79.99 sale Apparel folder — in progress, identity expansion Comfort Club — launched May 14, 2026 at $39.99/mo 10% credit-back on every order Free priority shipping Monthly socks + insoles Milestone gifts: tote (month 3), accessories (month 5), creator access (month 6) 70 subscribers at launch = ~$2.8K MRR Funnel Structure TOF Meta UGC ads — 95% of portfolio MOF Review check / nurse-friend validation BOF Cart-abandon — MISSING (0 retargeting creative) Post-purchase Comfort Club onboarding — MISSING Email + SMS active but sequences undocumented Performance History ROAS Trajectory 2.24 → 1.73 → 1.93 (declining as spend scales) 1,100+ active Meta ads but only ~40 unique creatives — 1,100 = same 40 cloned into ad-set permutations. At Home Dog Review — Lost Asset $466K spend · ~$45 CPA · $1M+ revenue Usage rights LOST. This is the most critical creative asset in the brand's history and it's gone. Must rebuild with permanent rights secured. Attribution Crisis — Every Decision Affected $60 ncCPA target vs ~$160 last-click vs ~$320 first-click. Triple disagreement means every creative ROI calculation is unreliable until reconciled. Week 1 priority. Key Strategic Notes CRITICAL: Top historical UGC winners are NON-NURSES framing product as nurse-endorsed. Opens aperture for actor-style formats. Content Calendar gap: Aug–Oct 2026 nearly empty. Q4 stacks 8 promos back-to-back, all BOGO-flavored. Channel urgency: 92% Meta concentration. TikTok paid is obvious next move. Drive access blockers: Creator folders (Adrianne, Breanna Seibel, Daniela Mendes, Anastasia, BM Digital Master) need Editor access for ad@adpros.com. Contact imbuedigital@gmail.com. STEP 2 Market Research & Intelligence Market Landscape, TAM, Trends & Opportunity Approved by Adrienne · May 15, 2026 $3B US Nurse Shoe Market (2026) $3.63B Projected by 2034 500K Unfilled Nurse Positions (2025) $99M TikTok Shop Footwear (Top 3, 12mo) True Market Redefinition (Levitt's Marketing Myopia) NB is NOT in the supportive footwear business. From the customer POV, NB is in: (1) Shift survival — vs. Advil, compression socks, ergonomic mats; (2) Caregiver identity — vs. FIGS, Jaanuu, Stanley; (3) Self-care permission — vs. Lululemon, Alo, Erewhon. The competitive set is FIGS + Stanley + Alo. Pricing Landscape Brand Price Range NB Position Cushionaire $35–50 floor Nurse Babes $69.99–79.99 ✓ owns this Skechers $60–85 — Snibbs ~$110 — Kuru $111–145 — Clove $149 — Hoka Bondi $140–175 — Anchor comparisons vs Hoka/Clove, not Skechers. TikTok Shop Opportunity TT Shop US footwear: $99M from top 3 brands (Apr 2025–Mar 2026). TT Shop US total: $15.82B in 2025, +120% H1 YoY. Crocs Bistro won TT Shop healthcare clog #1: $52.4M — running ZERO paid on Meta. Nurse Babes at $0 paid TT, organic only. TikTok is the single biggest immediate lever. Zero investment today, $99M category proven out. Customer Segments (5) 1. Bedside Brenda — 45% of base (PRIMARY) RN, 45–60+, 12-hr shifts. "I tried everything. I should have done this sooner." TX/FL/CA/PA/NY hubs. 2. Marisol the Service-Industry Sister — 20% Server/stylist/retail, 30–55. On feet all day on hard floors. 3. Cara the SAHM-on-her-feet — 12% Stay-at-home mom, 35–65. "I am not a nurse. I bought 11 pairs." 4. Teresa the Teacher-on-Her-Feet — 8% K-12 teacher, 28–60. Standing all day classroom-to-classroom. Jobs to Be Done Primary JTBD "Help me make it through my shift / day on feet without my body breaking down." Push: body breakdown after shift · Pull: nurse-built + affordable · Anxiety: will these actually work? · Habit: Hokas/Brooks/Skechers by default P1 White Space Opportunities (11 total) P1 Off-Duty Caregiver Identity Footwear Second silhouette (sneaker/slide) brunch-coded but signals tribe. No competitor owns nurse off the floor. P1 Repeat-Purchase Ritual / Subscription Quarterly drop + auto-replenish, member-only colorways. 6–11 pair repeaters have no structured re-order ritual. P1 TikTok Shop Nurse Creator Cartel 50–100 vetted nurse creators on revenue share + first-look drops. $0 paid TT today. P1 Fit & Shipping Anxiety Killer US 3PL for hero SKU + Try-a-Pair model + 60-day regret-proof return. China shipping = top conversion blocker.
